full_text:
Article 2 (Travel Expenses and Daily Allowances)
(1) Travel expenses (meaning transportation fares, daily travel allowances, accommodation expenses and meal expenses under the Regulations on Travel Expenses of Public Officials; hereinafter the same shall apply) and daily allowances may be paid to persons providing information, etc., within budgetary limits. <Amended on July 6, 2010; June 19, 2019; and April 30, 2026.>
(2) The standards for payment of travel expenses to persons providing information, etc. shall be governed, mutatis mutandis, by item 1 of attached Table 2 of the Regulations on Travel Expenses of Public Officials. <Amended on November 18, 1997; December 17, 1999; November 13, 2008; June 19, 2019; and April 30, 2026.>
